Title: Reflection Formula (Geometry)

Let $H$ be a [[Definition:Hilbert Space|Hilbert space]].

Let $v, a, \in H$ be [[Definition:Arbitrary|arbitrary]] [[Definition:Element|elements]] of $H$.

Let $A \subset H$ denote the [[Definition:Hyperplane|hyperplane]] [[Definition:Orthogonal|orthogonal]] to $a$.

The [[Definition:Reflection (Geometry)|reflection]] of $v$ through $A$ is given by:
:$\map {\operatorname {Ref}_a} v = v - 2 \dfrac {\langle v, a \rangle} {\langle a, a \rangle} a$
